name: A newly accrued period is offset by the advance balance
title: SC-07-05-02 A newly accrued period is offset by the advance balance
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a resident has an advance payment balance
When a new dues period is accrued
Then the new dues are automatically offset against the advance balance
